name: Fieldnote Photo & Check-in
tagline: A photographer and a check-in team for your event, with photos you can post the next morning.
bio: I'm June. I shoot dinners, meetups and booths in SF and NYC, and my team runs check-in so the first thing guests see is someone who knows their name.
terms: Free to cancel up to 7 days before.
backupPlan: Three photographers on the team; same style, same turnaround.

experiences.name: Event photographer
experiences.desc: Three hours of candid photos and a few posed group shots, edited and delivered in 48 hours.
experiences.allIn: Shooting, editing, 48-hour delivery and travel in SF and NYC.

experiences.name: Check-in staff with badges
experiences.desc: Two people at the door with your guest list, printed name badges and a QR scan.
experiences.allIn: Two staff, badge printing and tax.
